{{Quote|Lock onto both ships!|The officer to his technicians|<ref name="Blood Sisters" />}}
This '''[[Imperial officer]]''' was stationed onboard a light cruiser over [[Garel]]. He tried to stop [[Ketsu Onyo]] and [[Sabine Wren]] from escaping in a stolen shuttle, but the cruiser's [[tractor beam]] was destroyed when the shuttle, which the two women had rigged to explode, detonated near the cruiser.<ref name="Blood Sisters" />
